cases.description: Organizer creates a Draft meeting with a chair and a secretary; the meeting is the subject of every later case in this workflow.
procedure: Sign in as the Organizer and go to /mgmt/meetings.
Click "Tạo cuộc họp"; fill "Tên cuộc họp" with "[SYS] Họp giao ban tuần 49", "Ngày họp" tomorrow, "Bắt đầu" 09:00, "Kết thúc" 10:00, form Offline, sensitivity Thường.
In "Người dự họp" add Member A with role "Chủ toạ" and Member B with role "Thư ký".
Click "Tạo cuộc họp" and reload the detail page.
expected: Toast "Tạo cuộc họp thành công."; the browser opens the new meeting's detail page.
Status "Nháp" with the bar "Bản nháp — chưa gửi duyệt"; Member A is Chủ toạ, Member B is Thư ký.
After reload the data is unchanged; history has one row "Tạo cuộc họp"; no participant has a notification yet.
preconditions: Organizer, Member A, Member B, Member C and an Approver are active accounts (workflow precondition).

cases.description: Secretary of the meeting adds a member and invites an external guest to the Draft meeting from TC01.
procedure: Sign in as Member B (Thư ký) and open the TC01 meeting, tab "Thành phần tham dự".
Click "Thêm người dự họp", tick Member C, keep role "Thành viên" and confirm.
Click "Mời khách ngoài hệ thống", type "Trần Khách" and the guest email, click "Mời".
expected: Toast "Thêm thành phần tham dự thành công."; Member C is listed with chip "Thành viên".
Toast "Đã mời khách. Thư mời sẽ được gửi tới email của khách."; "Trần Khách" is listed with chip "Khách".
No email reaches the guest yet, because the meeting is not published.
preconditions: TC01 passed: Draft meeting exists with Member B as Thư ký.
A guest mailbox the tester can read.
cases.note: BF-02 · UC-28a · BR-88 · MSG96 · 5.2: PART_FT15, PART_FT25

cases.description: Secretary builds a two-item agenda and reorders it.
procedure: As Member B open tab "Nội dung cuộc họp" of the TC01 meeting.
Click "Thêm nội dung", type "Báo cáo tiến độ quý IV", presenter Member A; save. Add a second item "Dự toán ngân sách năm 2027", presenter Member C.
Drag item 2 above item 1 and reload.
expected: Both items are listed with their presenters.
After reload the order is "Dự toán ngân sách năm 2027", then "Báo cáo tiến độ quý IV".
preconditions: TC02 passed: Member C is on the roster.

cases.description: Secretary uploads a PDF to the meeting; another participant can open it.
procedure: As Member B open tab "Tài liệu" of the TC01 meeting and upload "bao-cao-quy-iv.pdf" (under the size limit).
Sign in as Member C in a second browser and open the same tab.
expected: Member B sees the file with the PDF icon, its size and uploader.
Member C sees and can open the file.
preconditions: TC02 passed; file storage is configured on the test build.

cases.description: Organizer submits the prepared meeting to the Approver.
procedure: As the Organizer open the TC01 meeting and click "Gửi duyệt".
In "Gửi duyệt cuộc họp" choose the Approver in "Chọn người duyệt" and click "Gửi duyệt".
Look for "Chỉnh sửa" on the meeting.
In a second browser signed in as the Approver open the notification bell.
expected: Toast "Đã gửi cuộc họp để duyệt."; status "Chờ duyệt"; bar "Đang chờ <Approver> duyệt".
The meeting information cannot be edited while waiting.
The Approver has a real-time notification that opens this meeting; history gains "Gửi duyệt".

cases.description: Approver rejects with a reason; the Organizer sees it, edits the meeting and resubmits.
procedure: As the Approver open the meeting from the notification and click "Từ chối".
Type "Cần bổ sung báo cáo tài chính." in "Lý do từ chối" and click "Từ chối".
As the Organizer open the notification, read the reason, click "Chỉnh sửa", change "Kết thúc" to 10:30 and save.
Click "Gửi duyệt" again to the same Approver.
expected: Toast "Đã từ chối cuộc họp."; status "Bị từ chối".
The Organizer's notification and the bar "Cuộc họp bị từ chối" both show the reason.
The edit saves; after resubmitting the status is "Chờ duyệt" again and the Approver gets a new notification.
History lists Gửi duyệt, Từ chối (with reason), Gửi duyệt, in that order.
preconditions: TC05 passed: meeting is Chờ duyệt, assigned to the Approver.
cases.note: BF-02 · UC-19, UC-15, UC-18 · MSG44, MSG78 · 5.2: MEET_FT50

cases.description: Approver approves the resubmitted meeting and the Organizer publishes it; participants and the guest are invited.
procedure: As the Approver open the meeting, click "Duyệt" and confirm.
As the Organizer open the notification, click "Công bố" and confirm.
As Member C open /mgmt/meetings and the bell; open the guest mailbox; open /calendar.
expected: Toast "Đã duyệt cuộc họp."; status "Đã duyệt"; Organizer notified.
Toast "Đã công bố cuộc họp."; status "Đã công bố"; meeting information is no longer editable (only rescheduling, WF-07).
Member A, B and C see the meeting in the list and have an invitation notification; the guest receives the invitation email with the meeting link.
The calendar shows the meeting tomorrow 09:00 to 10:30.
preconditions: TC06 passed: meeting is Chờ duyệt after resubmission.
cases.note: BF-02 · UC-19, UC-20 · BR-54 · MSG43, MSG45 · 5.2: MEET_FT49, MEET_FT55

cases.description: Invited members answer the invitation and the organizer sees the response status.
procedure: As Member C open the published meeting and click "Tham dự" in the bar "Bạn có tham dự cuộc họp này?"; reload.
As Member A open the same meeting on a phone (390px) and answer "Tham dự".
As the Organizer open tab "Thành phần tham dự".
expected: Toast "Đã ghi nhận phản hồi lời mời."; the bar disappears and stays gone after reload.
On the phone the bar and its buttons fit without horizontal scrolling.
The Organizer sees chip "Đã xác nhận tham dự" beside Member A and Member C; Member B has no answer chip yet.
preconditions: TC07 passed: meeting is Đã công bố.
